name: Mimi Tachikawa & Joe Kido
main_effect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have a suspended Digimon in play, gain 1 memory. If your opponent has a suspended Digimon in play, gain 1 memory.
 [Your Turn] When one of your green or blue Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, you may suspend this Tamer to ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
